title: Introduction to Community Health Work
description: Introduces the CHW role, its history, and its public health impact. Covers health equity, social determinants of health (SDOH), the healthcare system, and the policies — including the Affordable Care Act and the Triple Aim — that shape how CHWs work.
notes: Adapted from Calbright College CHW program outline (course 01 / CHW 501), renumbered per CCC convention.
lesson_length: Lab-guide lessons, roughly 1500-2000 words each, supporting instructor-led sessions and independent study
learning_objectives: Describe the CHW role, its history, and its public health impact
Explain health equity and identify social determinants of health affecting clients and communities
Describe how the healthcare system and policies like the ACA and Triple Aim shape CHW work

lessons.title: The CHW Role and Its History
objectives: Describe the CHW role, its history, and its public health impact
Locate the CHW role within care teams and community settings

lessons.title: Health Equity and Social Determinants of Health
objectives: Explain health equity and identify social determinants of health affecting clients and communities
Recognize community assets alongside needs when looking at health disparities

lessons.title: Navigating the U.S. Healthcare System
objectives: Describe how clients experience the U.S. healthcare system and where CHWs help them navigate it
Explain coverage basics (Medicaid/Medi-Cal, Medicare, marketplace plans) at a client-support level

lessons.title: Policy Foundations: The ACA and the Triple Aim
objectives: Describe how the healthcare system and policies like the ACA and Triple Aim shape CHW work
Connect policy-level decisions to the barriers clients experience locally

lessons.title: The Public Health Impact of CHWs
objectives: Explain the evidence for CHW impact on outcomes, cost, and equity
Distinguish program outputs from outcomes in CHW impact studies

sequencing_rationale: Course 1 of 6 (adapted from the Calbright College CHW outline, renumbered CHW101-CHW106). Foundational knowledge course: role and history first, then the equity lens (SDOH), then the system and policy context CHWs operate in, closing with the evidence for CHW impact. Scope assumption: this course is knowledge-heavy while the skills matrix is behavior-based, so lessons tag the matrix competencies they genuinely advance (SDOH identification, system navigation, policy-level advocacy, metrics literacy) and the purely descriptive content (role history, C3 overview) is raised as proposed competencies rather than force-tagged.

proposed_competencies.competency_text: The learner can describe the CHW role, its history, and the C3 framework that defines its scope of practice.
proposed_competencies.rationale: CHW101 lesson 2 teaches role identity and history; the skills matrix is behavior-based and has no role-knowledge competency.
